d:
Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : bihar ke bahubli neta aur purv vidhayak anant sinh ke ghar beti ki shadi ko lekar nadvan men utsavi mahaul hai. shadi samaroh ke lie bhavy taiyariyan ki gaee hain. mehmanon ki khatirdari ke lie karib 300 chulhon par khana banaya ja raha hai. desh-videsh se mehman shadi men shamil hone pahunch rahe hain.
Isi bich kendriy mantri lalan sinh bhi anant sinh ke ghar shadi samaroh men shamil hone barh pahunche. dekhie anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ki taiyariyan, mehmanon ka svagat aur nadvan se juri har khas tasvira.
